Footer.title: Get in touch!
Footer.text: We want you to feel welcome. If you have a question we haven't answered here, get in touch as fast as you can. We love questions — we're from Bergen, after all.

Testimonials.isak: I think diving is really cool, and I love being in the club.
Testimonials.varin: Being part of this community is incredibly fun. For me, diving has become a weekly balm for the mind.
Testimonials.julie: The club is a family — I've known these people as long as my own family.
Testimonials.synne: It's a really nice community, and diving is great fun. Both the coaches and the other divers are kind.

signup.title: Sign up for diving school, autumn 2026
signup.text1: With its focus on physical and mental learning, diving challenges sides of yourself you didn't know existed. It tests limits in a safe and fun way — right in the heart of Bergen.
